DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 道具を使う前に、下書きを一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: Before using the tools, let's look at your sketch together.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 模様の端が材料の縁に近くなりました。そのまま進めてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintJa: 縁に近い模様を加工前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: The edge of the pattern has ended up close to the edge of the material. I'm not sure whether to continue as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintTranslation: Ask about the pattern being close to the edge before working on it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 作業する範囲を先に確認します。どの部分を残したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: Let's check the working area first. Which part would you like to keep?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 中央の花は残したいです。外側の飾りだけ減らせるなら、全体を消さずに直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintJa: 残したい中心模様と減らせる部分を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: I'd like to keep the flower in the center. If I can reduce just the outer decoration, I'd like to fix it without erasing the whole thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintTranslation: Distinguish the central pattern you want to keep from the parts you can reduce. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: まだ加工していないので、下書きの位置から相談できます。まず道具を台へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: Since you haven't worked on the material yet, we can discuss the position of the sketch. Please put the tool on the workbench first.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 台へ置きました。持ったまま鉛筆で線を直すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintJa: 道具を置いて下書きだけを修正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: I've put it on the workbench. I won't correct the pencil lines while holding the tool.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintTranslation: Explain that you will put the tool down and correct only the sketch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: この外側の飾りを省けば、作業範囲に収まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: If you leave out this outer decoration, the pattern will fit within the working area.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 花を小さくするより、その飾りを省きます。消す線を指して確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintJa: 省く飾りを選び消す線の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: I'll leave out that decoration rather than make the flower smaller. Could you point to the lines to erase and check them with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintTranslation: Choose the decoration to omit and ask to check which lines to erase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 省くのはこちらの二本です。修正後、もう一度下書きを見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: These are the two lines to leave out. Please show me the sketch again after correcting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 二本を消しました。ここまでを確認していただいてから、加工の説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintJa: 二本の修正を報告して加工前の再確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: I've erased the two lines. Once you've checked what I've done so far, I'll listen to the instructions for working on the material.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.hintTranslation: Report that you have corrected the two lines and ask for another check before starting work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.sourceJa: 残す模様と作業範囲が整理できました。道具の説明でまたお会いしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-06-001-SH.translation: We've clarified the pattern to keep and the working area. I'll see you again for the explanation of the tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: 薬剤師からの説明で、確認しておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: Is there anything from the pharmacist's explanation that you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: 説明中はうなずきましたが、帰ってから自分で説明できるか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintJa: うなずいたが服薬説明を再現する自信がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: I nodded during the explanation, but I'm not confident that I could explain it myself once I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintTranslation: Explain that you nodded but are not confident you can repeat the medication instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: 覚えたことを薬剤師へ伝えて、合っているか確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: You can tell the pharmacist what you remember and check whether it's correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: 自分の言葉で言ってみたいです。違っていたら、その場で直してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintJa: 自分の理解を言い直し訂正を受ける方法を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: I'd like to try saying it in my own words. If I get something wrong, could they correct me there and then?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintTranslation: Ask to explain your understanding in your own words and have any mistakes corrected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: そのご希望を薬剤師へ伝えます。どの点から確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: I'll pass that request on to the pharmacist. Which point would you like to check first?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: まず飲むタイミングです。今ここで自分の判断を増やさず、いただいた説明を言い直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintJa: 飲む時点から説明を再現して確認したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: First, when to take it. I'll repeat the explanation I was given, without adding my own interpretations here.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintTranslation: Say you would like to start by repeating and checking when to take the medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: 説明の紙と薬の袋を一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: Please bring both the instruction sheet and the medicine bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: 紙を読んだだけで理解できたことにはせず、袋と対応させて質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintJa: 説明書と袋を対応させて質問すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: I won't assume I've understood just because I've read the sheet. I'll match it to the bag and ask my questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintTranslation: Explain that you will match the instruction sheet to the medicine bag when asking questions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: ご自宅で分からなくなった場合の連絡方法も、薬剤師に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: Please also ask the pharmacist how to contact them if you become unsure about something at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: 理解の確認と連絡先の二点を聞きます。分からないまま帰らず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintJa: 理解確認と帰宅後の連絡方法を相談事項にまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: I'll ask about those two things: checking my understanding and the contact details. I'd like to ask for help rather than go home still unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.hintTranslation: Summarize your questions as checking your understanding and how to contact them after going home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.sourceJa: ご希望は薬剤師へ引き継ぎます。確認してからお帰りください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-07-001-SH.translation: I'll pass your request on to the pharmacist. Please check before you leave. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: お会計をご希望ですね。こちらのお席は皆様ご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: You'd like the bill, is that right? Is everyone at this table together?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: 後から一人加わりました。その人がカウンターで頼んだ物も同じ会計に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintJa: 遅れて合流した人の別注文が卓の会計に含まれるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: One person joined us later. Is what they ordered at the counter included in this bill too?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintTranslation: Ask whether the latecomer's separate order is included in the table's bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: 別の注文記録があるか確認します。合流された方に内容を聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: I'll check whether there is a separate order record. Could you ask the person who joined you what they ordered?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: 聞きます。飲物を一杯頼んだそうですが、こちらの卓では追加していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintJa: 本人に聞いた飲物の注文場所と数量を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: I'll ask. They say they ordered one drink, but we didn't add it to the order at this table.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintTranslation: Explain where the person ordered their drink and how many they ordered, based on what they told you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: その飲物の記録はこちらの卓と分かれています。まとめるかは担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: The record for that drink is separate from this table's. I'll ask the staff member in charge whether we can combine them.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: 二重に追加せず、先に二つの記録の合計を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintJa: 二重追加せず別記録の合計を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: I'd like to know the combined total of the two records first, without adding the drink twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintTranslation: Ask to check the combined total of the separate records without adding anything twice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: それぞれの明細をお見せします。まとめて精算するご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: I'll show you each itemized bill. Would you like to pay them together?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: 精算はまとめたいです。ただ、人数で割る額は、明細を見てから仲間と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintJa: 一括精算と仲間内の負担計算を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: We'd like to pay them together. But we'll discuss how much to split among ourselves after looking at the itemized bills.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintTranslation: Distinguish paying together from working out each person's share. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: まとめられるか確認してから、最終の金額をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: I'll check whether we can combine them, then let you know the final amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: 最終の明細を確認して支払います。飲物一杯を自分たちで足して計算するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintJa: 最終明細に従い自己計算で一杯分を加えないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: We'll check the final itemized bill before paying. We'll stop trying to calculate it ourselves by adding the price of one drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.hintTranslation: Say you will follow the final itemized bill and will not add the drink yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.sourceJa: 別の記録も含めた精算のご希望を承りました。ご来店ありがとうございました。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-FUJIKAWAGUCHIKO-08-001-SH.translation: I've noted that you'd like to settle the bill including the separate order. Thank you for visiting. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝の申し送りを読んだか。いまの様子も伝えてくれ。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you read the morning handover? Tell me how things are now, too.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝の記録には水を飲まなかったとあります。私が見た時間には一度飲みました。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝の申し送りと現在の飲水観察の違いを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-02.translation: The morning record says it didn't drink any water. During the time I was watching, it drank once.
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the difference between the morning handover and your current observation of drinking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ時間の観察としてまとめないようにしよう。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's make sure we don't combine those as observations from the same time.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝の記録は残します。私の観察には、見始めた時刻と飲んだ時刻を別に書きます。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 過去の記録を残して自分の観察時刻を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll keep the morning record. In my own observation, I'll write separately the time I started watching and the time it drank.
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Keep the earlier record and distinguish the times of your own observations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲んだ量まで分かったか。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Were you able to tell how much it drank?

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 量は測っていません。口を水へ付けたことだけで十分な量を飲んだとは書けません。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲水量が未測定で十分な量とは判断できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I didn't measure the amount. I can't write that it drank enough just because it put its mouth to the water.
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the amount drunk was not measured and you cannot judge whether it was enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その範囲でよい。状態の判断は担当に任せてくれ。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's enough detail. Leave the assessment of its condition to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度飲んだから心配ないとは言いません。気になる動きもあれば、そのまま知らせます。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 状態を断定せず気になる動きを報告すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't say there's nothing to worry about just because it drank once. If I notice any concerning movements, I'll report exactly what I see.
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will report concerning movements without making a definite assessment of its condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の担当にも、時間が違う記録だと説明しておこう。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's explain to the next person in charge, too, that the records are from different times.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 朝の情報と自分が見た事実を二段に分けて引き継ぎます。量は未確認と明記します。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時間別の観察と未確認の量を次の担当へ引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hand over the morning information and what I personally observed in two separate sections. I'll clearly state that the amount is unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the observations separated by time and the unconfirmed amount to the next person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 観察した範囲が分かる記録で助かる。担当へ渡しておく。では、次の交代で。
DLG-SC-YMN-HOKUTO-001-SHARED-11.translation: A record that makes the limits of your observations clear is helpful. I'll pass it to the person in charge. See you at the next handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨の中、お越しいただきました。お荷物はまだ車内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you for coming in the rain. Is your luggage still in the car?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先に全部降ろすと濡れそうなので、受付と区画の確認を先に済ませたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物の濡れを避け受付と区画確認を先に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It looks as though it would get wet if we unloaded everything first, so I'd like to finish checking in and confirming our site first.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check in and confirm your site first to keep your luggage from getting wet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の確認は、こちらの屋根の下でできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can check your reservation here under the roof.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 代表の私だけ来ました。同行者は車内で待っています。必要なら呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代表だけが受付に来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only I've come over as the group representative. The others are waiting in the car. I'll call them over if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only the group representative has come to reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず代表のお名前と予約の控えをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, may I have the representative's name and reservation confirmation, please?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この控えです。受付が終わっても、空いて見える区画へ勝手に荷物を置かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えを示し区画未確定で荷物を置かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's the confirmation. Even after checking in, we won't put our luggage on a site that looks empty without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the confirmation and say you will not put your luggage down before your site is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 区画を確定してから、搬入の道順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once we've confirmed your site, we'll explain the route for bringing your belongings in.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道順は同行者にも伝えたいです。車を動かす前に、一緒に案内を聞いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車を動かす前に同行者と道順を聞きたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like the others to know the route, too. Could we listen to the directions together before moving the car?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to hear the route with the others before moving the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ここへ来られたら、二人で案内図をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Once the other person comes here, please check the map together.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行者を呼びます。行先と搬入方法が分かってから、必要な荷物だけ順に降ろします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 共同確認後に必要な荷物から降ろすと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll call them over. After we understand where we're going and how to bring things in, we'll unload just the things we need, in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to unload the necessary luggage first after checking the information together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 屋根の下で受付を進め、区画案内をお待ちください。それでは、案内担当に代わります。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed with check-in under the roof and wait for the site directions. I'll hand you over to the person giving directions. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 果物は今日召し上がる分をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for fruit to eat today?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日の分と、数日後に食べる分がほしいです。全部を同じ日に食べる予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日と後日の果物の消費予定を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like some for today and some to eat a few days from now. I don't plan to eat it all on the same day.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain separately your plans for eating fruit today and on later days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べる予定を分けて選びましょう。どなたと召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's choose according to when you plan to eat it. Who will you be eating it with?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人です。大袋が安く見えますが、食べ切れるかも考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人用の量と大袋を食べ切れるかの迷いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's just for me. The large bag looks cheaper, but I'd also like to consider whether I can finish it.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how much you need for one person and your concern about finishing a large bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小分けの品もあります。保存の案内は品ごとの表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have smaller packs, too. Please check each product's label for storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この小分けなら、まず今日の分だけ買えます。表示も見たいので、袋を向けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小分け品を選び保存表示を見せてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: With this smaller pack, I can buy just what I need for today first. I'd like to read the label, too. Could you turn the bag toward me?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a smaller pack and ask to see the storage label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに保存の案内があります。後の日の分も今お求めになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The storage instructions are here. Would you like to buy the fruit for later days now, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は無理にまとめ買いせず、この一袋にします。残りは予定を見て買い足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後日の予定を見て買い足す方針を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't force myself to buy it all at once today. I'll take this one bag. I'll buy more for the other days once I've checked my plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to buy more after checking your plans for later days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの一袋ですね。値段は棚のこの表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: This one bag, then. The price is shown here on the shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一袋の価格を確認しました。大袋の表示と混ぜず、この品を会計へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 選んだ一袋の価格を確かめて会計へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the price for one bag. I'll take this item to the checkout without confusing its price label with the large bag's.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the price of your chosen bag and proceed to the checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な量でお選びいただけましたね。それでは、お買物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've chosen the amount you need. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のパンのお受取りですか。予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to pick up reserved bread? May I have the name on the reservation, please?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 佐藤です。用事が早く終わったので、予定より一時間早く来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約品を予定より早く取りに来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's Sato. My errand finished early, so I've come an hour earlier than planned.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have come earlier than planned to collect your reserved items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご予約分は、約束した時刻に合わせて用意しています。いまはまだお渡しできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We're preparing your reserved items for the agreed time. We can't hand them over yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 早く来ても仕上がっているとは限りませんね。受取りは予約した時刻のままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未準備の案内を理解し元の受取時刻を維持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Coming early doesn't necessarily mean they'll be ready, does it? Please keep the pickup time as originally reserved.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the items are not ready and keep the original pickup time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。待つ間に、店頭の品をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. Would you like to look at the items on display while you wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今食べる物を一つ買いたいです。ただ、予約した数量から一つ引くわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店頭の一個を予約数量の減少と分けて希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to buy one thing to eat now. But that doesn't mean taking one off the quantity I reserved.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for one item from the display while distinguishing it from a reduction in your reserved quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店頭分は別の購入として伺います。予約はそのまま残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll treat the item from the display as a separate purchase. Your reservation will remain unchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、この一つを追加で買います。受取りに戻るときに、予約の控えもまた持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加の一個を選び予約の控えを持って戻ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll buy this one as an extra. I'll bring the reservation confirmation again when I return to pick up my order.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one extra item and say you will bring the reservation confirmation when you return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約品と店頭分の会計は、それぞれの案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the payment instructions for the reserved items and the item from the display separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の追加購入のレシートを、予約の受取証明と取り違えないよう別にしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加購入のレシートと予約受取の控えを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the receipt for today's extra purchase separately so I don't mistake it for proof of collecting my reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the receipt for the extra purchase from the confirmation for collecting your reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約の時刻と数量はそのまま承りました。それでは、予定のお時間にお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've kept your reservation time and quantity unchanged. We'll see you at the scheduled time.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会議室のご予約ですか、それとも下見でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to reserve a meeting room, or are you here to look around?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は下見です。使うか決める前に、机を並べたときの広さを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 利用予約ではなく配置を確かめる下見を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm here to look around today. Before deciding whether to use it, I'd like to see how much space there is with the tables set up.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a viewing to check the layout rather than make a reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 下見で案内できるか確認します。人数はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check whether we can show you around. Have you decided how many people there will be?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予定は六人ですが、まだ参加者にはここへ来るよう伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定人数と参加者に来場を依頼していないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: We're planning for six, but I haven't told the participants to come here yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the planned number of people and explain that you have not asked the participants to come. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は見ていただけます。机や椅子は、確認せず動かさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can take a look now. Please don't move the tables or chairs without checking with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 動かさず配置を見ます。六人で向き合えるか、案内図に印を付けて考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 備品を動かさず図上で六人の配置を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll look at the layout without moving anything. I'd like to mark the floor plan and consider whether six people can sit facing one another.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider a seating arrangement for six on the plan without moving the furniture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しする案内図へ記入できます。下見が終わったら受付へお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can write on the floor plan we give you. Please return to reception when you've finished looking.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付へ戻ります。その時点で予約を決められなくても、いったん持ち帰ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 下見後に受付へ戻り判断を持ち帰れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll come back to reception. If I still can't decide about booking then, may I take the information home to think it over?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return to reception after the viewing and ask whether you can decide later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、下見は予約の確定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, looking around does not confirm a reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、机の配置を確認して仲間に相談します。利用日は相談後に申込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仲間との相談後に利用日を申し込むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll check the table layout and discuss it with the others. I'll apply for a date after we've talked it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to apply for a date after discussing it with the others. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 下見と予約を分けて進めてください。それでは、お部屋の確認へいってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please treat the viewing and reservation as separate steps. Enjoy your look around the room.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の味付けについて、振り返りに書くことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to write in your reflection about today's seasoning?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中で自分の好みに合わせて調整しました。配布レシピと同じ量を使ったとは書けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中調整で配布レシピ通りの使用量ではないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I adjusted it to my own taste partway through. I can't write that I used the same quantities as in the recipe we were given.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your adjustments mean the quantities used did not match the distributed recipe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこを変えたか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know what you changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 酸味が強く感じたので、最後の調味料を少なめにしました。正確な量は測っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 酸味の好みによる減量と未測定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It tasted too sour to me, so I used less of the last seasoning. I didn't measure the exact amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you reduced the seasoning to suit your taste for sourness and did not measure it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 測っていない量を数字で作らず、分かる変更を記録しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's record the changes you know about without making up figures for quantities you didn't measure.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「最後の調味料を減らした、量は未測定」と書きます。レシピの数字を私の実測値にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明な量を作らず変更内容を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write, 'Reduced the final seasoning; amount not measured.' I won't present the recipe's figures as quantities I actually measured.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record the changes without inventing unknown quantities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出来上がりの感想も、変更の記録とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also keep your impressions of the finished dish separate from the record of changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 酸味が自分にはちょうどよかったと書きます。ほかの人にも同じ好みだとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 味の感想を変更量や他人の好みと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write that the sourness was just right for me. I won't say that everyone else has the same taste.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your impressions of the taste from the quantities changed and other people's preferences. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次回、再現したい場合は調整する量を測って記録すると比較できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you want to reproduce it next time, measuring and recording the adjusted amounts will let you compare them.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次は加えた量を残します。今日のレシピと自分の変更メモを並べて見返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回の測定記録と元レシピとの比較を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next time, I'll record the amounts I add. I'll review today's recipe and my own notes on the changes side by side.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to measure and record quantities next time and compare them with the original recipe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 使用量と感想を分けた振り返りですね。では、次の実習でまたお会いしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your reflection separates the amounts used from your impressions. I'll see you at the next practical session.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この商品のポイント案内について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about this product's points offer?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示の分が今日の支払いから引かれるのか知りたいです。手持ちの現金で足りるか考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ポイント表示が当日の値引きか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to know whether the amount shown is deducted from today's payment. I'm working out whether the cash I have is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the points shown are a discount on today's purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内は後から付くポイントです。今日の値引きではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This offer is for points credited later. It isn't a discount today.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、いま払う額は値札の方ですね。ポイントを現金の残りへ足して考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後日付与と値札の支払額の違いを理解して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then the amount I pay now is the price on the price tag, right? I was adding the points to the cash I had left.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your understanding of the difference between points credited later and the payment amount on the price tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日のお支払い額で比較してください。別の容量もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please compare the amounts you would pay today. There's another size, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい方の支払額も知りたいです。あとで付くポイントではなく、今日払える額で選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日の予算で小容量の商品を比較したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to know the amount I'd pay for the smaller size, too. I'll choose based on what I can pay today, rather than points credited later.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the smaller product based on today's budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい方の値段はこちらです。ご予算には収まりそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The price of the smaller one is here. Does it look as though it will fit your budget?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 収まります。必要量も足りるので、小さい方を一つにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予算と必要量に合う小容量一つを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. It's enough for what I need, too, so I'll take one of the smaller size.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one smaller product that meets your budget and quantity needs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご購入数は一つですね。ほかの品と一緒に会計される場合は合計もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you're buying one. If you pay for it with other items, please check the total as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はこの一つだけです。ポイントは後の記録に分け、レジの支払額を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一品だけの精算額と後日のポイント記録を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is the only item I'm buying today. I'll keep the points in a separate record for later and check the amount to pay at the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the payment for this single item from the later record of points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日の費用で選べましたね。それでは、レジへどうぞ。お買物ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMN-HOKUTO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've made your choice based on today's cost. Please proceed to the register. Thank you for shopping with us.
